units.text: 是的，有特殊规则（称为“工作激励”）帮助您在测试工作能力时保留现金福利和Medicare。

units.text: 您需要及时向社会保障局报告您回去工作的情况。
supporting_chunk_ids: Benefits Planner: Disability | Are You Working | Social Security Administration#2_0::c0000
units.reason: The context says 'you are responsible for promptly reporting any improvement in your condition, or if you return to work.'

units.text: 如果您的月收入超过一定水平（2019年通常为每月1,220美元，盲人为2,040美元），可能被视为“实质性工作”，这可能导致福利停止。
supporting_chunk_ids: Benefits Planner: Disability | Are You Working | Social Security Administration#2_0::c0000
units.reason: The context states that in 2019, average earnings of $1,220 or more per month ($2,040 if blind) are usually considered substantial, and working at a substantial level can cause benefits to stop.
